channel.title: Tank Metrics — Startups, Shark Tank and Money in Rupees
channel.description: Shark Tank India deals, startup valuation and the money maths behind Indian businesses, explained in plain English and Hinglish.

item.title: Meesho Now Owns 93% of the Kirana Price App
item.description: Meesho paid ₹186.71 crore for Kirana Club and took its stake to 93%. Here is the maths of a 41-lakh-shop network, and what it means at your own counter.

item.title: Credit Line on UPI: What a $10 Mn Round Means for Shops
item.description: Vegapay raised $10 Mn to put bank credit lines on UPI QR codes. Here is the arithmetic of what a single credit-paying customer is worth at a shop counter.

item.title: What a Dark Store Franchise Really Earns
item.description: Dark store franchise maths in rupees: the margin one order really leaves, the fixed costs that run anyway, and the payback a quick-commerce store delivers.

item.title: Zavya raises ₹22.6 crore at 32 times its sales
item.description: Silver jewellery brand Zavya raised ₹22.6 crore at a ₹191.5 crore valuation. Its ₹6 crore of FY25 sales left just ₹54.7 lakh of profit, or under 1% margin.

item.title: COD and RTO: Where Your Profit Goes
item.description: RTO and COD returns quietly eat D2C profit. See what one failed delivery really costs, how to price it into every order, and how to cut your RTO rate.

item.title: Shree Anandhaas raises ₹110 crore at 7x sales
item.description: A 61-outlet sweets chain from Coimbatore has raised ₹110 crore and a ₹1,908 crore tag. Its ₹284 crore of sales last year left just ₹7.64 crore of profit.

item.title: FD Interest After TDS: What You Really Keep
item.description: FD interest is taxed at your own slab rate, and the bank deducts TDS once yearly interest crosses the limit. See what a fixed deposit really leaves you.

item.title: Style Union's ₹485 Crore Round: ₹7 Crore a Store
item.description: Style Union raised ₹485 crore to open 250 more stores. The maths behind the round: each store now earns about ₹7 crore a year, up from ₹3 crore in FY23.

item.title: Advance Tax: The Four Dates Founders Miss
item.description: Advance tax explained in rupees: who must pay, the four instalment dates, what a missed quarter costs in interest, and how to set the money aside monthly.

item.title: FD Rates Are Rising: Where a Shop Owner Parks Cash
item.description: Banks raised FD rates across November after the RBI's October hike. Here is the arithmetic of locking in now versus waiting for the December 4 decision.

item.title: Mutual Fund Exit Load Explained
item.description: Exit load is the fee a mutual fund charges when you sell units early. Learn how it is calculated, which funds charge it, and how to time a redemption.

item.title: Boba Bhai's $18M Round: What One Store Must Earn
item.description: Boba Bhai raised $18 million with 120 stores and Rs 70 crore of FY26 sales. Here is what each outlet must ring up, and why fast growth still burns cash.

item.title: Property Valuation: Area × Rate Explained
item.description: Property valuation in India: how carpet area times the going per sq ft rate sets a flat's worth, what moves that rate, and why a bank's valuation is lower.

item.title: Mudra Guarantee Extended to 2031: Fee Cut to 0.75%
item.description: A Rs 5,000 crore fund backs collateral-free Mudra loans up to Rs 20 lakh until 2031, and the guarantee fee fell from 1% to 0.75%. Here is what a shop saves.

item.title: Employee Productivity Rate: The Formula
item.description: Employee productivity rate explained: the formula, a worked example from a small Indian workshop, and how to compare output per employee fairly every month.

item.title: Henfruit Raises $15 Million: A ₹7 Egg, ₹350 Crore Brand
item.description: Egg brand Henfruit took its first outside money in 12 years. The unit maths behind it: ₹350 crore of sales, four crore eggs a month, and about ₹7 an egg.

item.title: Festive Sales Up 29%: Smaller Baskets, More Orders
item.description: Festive retail is set to hit Rs 1.55 lakh crore, up 29%, but the average basket fell 1.5%. Here is what more, smaller orders mean for a small shop's margins.

item.title: Contribution Margin: What Each Sale Adds
item.description: Contribution margin is selling price minus variable cost. See the formula, a ₹500 worked example, and why the ratio matters more than the rupees you keep.

item.title: India Deep Tech Raised $914M: The Growth Gap
item.description: India's deep tech startups raised $914 million in 2025, yet they took only 1.6% of the world's capital. Here is what that funding gap means for a founder.

item.title: How to Set Your Freelancer Hourly Rate
item.description: Freelancers undercharge by dividing target income by every working hour. See the one-line formula, a worked example, and the costs a real rate must cover.

item.title: A2B Sells Majority Stake to Bodhi Tree for $180M
item.description: A 50-year-old Chennai food chain sold a majority stake for $180 million. Here is the arithmetic behind the valuation, and what a small shop can take from it.

item.title: Rental Yield Explained: What Your Flat Earns
item.description: Rental yield explained: yearly rent as a percent of the flat's price, a ₹9,000 rent worked through, gross vs net yield, and why brokers quote the higher one.

item.title: Startup Funding Fell 88% in a Week: What It Signals
item.description: Indian startups raised just $31.3 million in the week to November 14, down nearly 88% from $258.1 million a week earlier. What that swing means for founders.

item.title: GST Penalties as Charges: What It Saves Your Shop
item.description: GST penalties settled on time may be treated as charges, not penalties, so a shop can deduct them from taxable profit. Here is the maths for a small business.

item.title: Wine Shop Profit Margin: What You Keep
item.description: A wine shop runs on a thin 20% margin. See a ₹600 bottle worked through, the monthly fixed costs, and the break-even bottles a shop must sell each month.

item.title: Hardware Shop Profit Margin: What You Keep
item.description: Hardware shop profit margin explained: a ₹500 sale worked through, the fixed costs it must cover, and the dead stock and contractor credit that cut it.

item.title: Inflation Hits 6.09%: What It Costs a Small Shop
item.description: India's retail inflation hit 6.09% in October, past the RBI's 6% limit, as food prices jumped 8.94%. Here is exactly what that does to a small shop's margin.

item.title: GST E-Invoicing Widens to Reverse-Charge Bills in 2027
item.description: From January 1, 2027, firms above ₹5 crore turnover must raise an e-invoice for reverse-charge self-invoices and imported services. Here is the maths.

item.title: CTC vs In-Hand Salary: What You Really Get
item.description: CTC vs in-hand salary explained for Indian founders: what the employer really pays, what is deducted from gross pay, and what lands in the bank each month.

item.title: Startup Funding Up 69%: Five Deals Took 83%
item.description: Indian startups raised $290.55 million in the week to November 7, 2026, up 69% on the week. But five rounds took 83% of it. Here is what that maths means.
